name: verify_project_domain
description:
Attempts to verify a project domain with `verified = false` by checking the correctness of the project domain's `verification` challenge.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v9/projects/{idOrName}/domains/{domain}/verify --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

domain.description: The domain name you want to verify

idOrName.description: The unique project identifier or the project name

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
